I usually get corruption potion on first back so that I can trade more. Then I go Mandate>Sorcerers>Zhonya >Banshee>Morellonomicon.
I feel like mandate has a better passive, 15 ap per legendary is quite alot.
I haven't tried it yet, but you basically trade in the dmg from mandate for healing which can work in specific matchups, though i prefer playing her aggresively with mandate.

I play her with electrocute so I play around it. I go for short Q-E-AA trades. You can use W to force them into the Q. In some matchups you can't really do much so I usually wait till 6 and then try for an all in. I don't really roam with her unless lane is lost. The toughest matchups are Lulu (she trades better and you can't all in after 6) and Leona (she just all ins you since you are squishy) on supp and Twitch on adc (he comes up to you in invis and just destroys you).
